boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain The Catholic University of America
boards.description: Ten currently documented Washington food destinations with late hours for an under-21-safe off-campus meal plan.

cards.entity_name: Papa Johns Pizza Brentwood Place NE
cards.title: Papa Johns Pizza Brentwood Place NE
cards.subtitle: 1348 Brentwood Place NE, Washington, DC
cards.notes: Use the official ordering page to confirm the day before leaving; Friday and Saturday carryout is listed through 2:45 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A late carryout pizza option with official weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns lists Friday and Saturday carryout at this location from 10:00 a.m. to 2:45 a.m.
cards.source_title: Papa Johns Pizza Brentwood Place NE
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Friday–Saturday carryout until 2:45 a.m.; verify holiday changes before travel.

cards.entity_name: Papa Johns Pizza Otis Place NW
cards.title: Papa Johns Pizza Otis Place NW
cards.subtitle: 1417 Otis Place NW, Washington, DC
cards.notes: Order carryout before heading over; the official page lists Thursday through Saturday pickup until 12:15 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A pickup-focused pizza stop with midnight-plus hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns lists carryout at Otis Place NW until 12:15 a.m. Thursday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: Papa Johns Pizza Otis Place NW
cards.access_notes: Official carryout hours run to 12:15 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; delivery is listed until 1:00 a.m. those nights.

cards.title: Papa Johns Pizza 5th Street NW
cards.subtitle: 924 5th Street NW, Washington, DC
cards.notes: Plan for a late pickup or delivery window: Friday and Saturday delivery is posted through 2:00 a.m. and carryout through 12:40 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A documented weekend delivery and carryout option.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns lists Friday and Saturday delivery until 2:00 a.m. and carryout until 12:40 a.m. at 924 5th Street NW.
cards.access_notes: Official hours list Friday–Saturday delivery through 2:00 a.m.; confirm delivery coverage for your location.

cards.entity_name: Taco Bell Cantina H Street NE
cards.title: Taco Bell Cantina H Street NE
cards.subtitle: 625 H Street NE, Washington, DC
cards.notes: Check the location page before making the trip; it identifies this food location as open late and lists 24-hour dine-in on Thursday.
cards.short_summary: A fast-food option with a documented all-night Thursday.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists its 625 H Street NE location as open late and shows Thursday dine-in hours as open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Cantina — 625 H Street NE
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Thursday dine-in as open 24 hours; check the live location page for other days and holidays.

cards.title: Taco Bell 14th Street NW
cards.subtitle: 3100 14th Street NW, Suite 103, Washington, DC
cards.notes: Use the official location listing to confirm today’s schedule; it identifies this restaurant as open late and open 24 hours.
cards.short_summary: A 14th Street food stop listed as 24 hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s Washington location listing identifies the 3100 14th Street NW restaurant as open 24 hours and open late.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurants in Washington, DC
cards.access_notes: The official Washington locator lists this restaurant as open 24 hours; verify the live store page before departure.

cards.title: Taco Bell 8th Street SE
cards.subtitle: 411 8th Street SE, Washington, DC
cards.notes: Time a weekend visit using the official listing: Friday dine-in hours are posted through 3:00 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A late Friday fast-food option in Southeast DC.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists Friday dine-in hours at 411 8th Street SE from 7:00 a.m. to 3:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Friday dine-in through 3:00 a.m.; review the location page for current day-specific hours.

cards.title: IHOP 14th Street NW
cards.subtitle: 3100 14th Street NW, Washington, DC
cards.notes: Use the location page to pick a late window: Friday and Saturday are listed as open 24 hours, with dine-in and online ordering available.
cards.short_summary: All-day breakfast with documented 24-hour weekend service.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP lists Friday and Saturday at 3100 14th Street NW as open 24 hours and identifies the location as offering late-night food.
cards.source_title: IHOP Late Night Food — 3100 14th Street NW
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Friday and Saturday as open 24 hours; remaining day schedules vary and should be checked before travel.

cards.title: Buho's Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 3521 14th Street NW, Washington, DC
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s order page for a late meal; it posts daily closing at 2:00 a.m., extended to 3:00 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A restaurant with posted nightly and weekend-late hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Buho's Restaurant lists hours until 2:00 a.m. Sunday through Thursday and until 3:00 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official site posts service through 2:00 a.m. daily and through 3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; confirm special-date hours.

cards.title: DC Pizza
cards.subtitle: 1103 19th Street NW, Washington, DC
cards.notes: Save this for the end of the week: the restaurant posts Thursday hours through 3:00 a.m. and Friday–Saturday hours through 4:00 a.m.
cards.short_summary: Pizza with especially late posted Thursday-to-Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: DC Pizza lists Thursday hours until 3:00 a.m. and Friday and Saturday hours until 4:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Thursday until 3:00 a.m. and Friday–Saturday until 4:00 a.m.; Monday–Wednesday and Sunday close earlier.

cards.title: Pizza Boli's Adams Morgan
cards.subtitle: 1511 U Street NW, Washington, DC
cards.notes: Use the official location page for a late pickup or delivery plan; it lists service through 3:00 a.m. most nights and 4:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A pizza-and-subs location with daily late-night hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Boli's lists its Adams Morgan location open until 3:00 a.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday, and until 4:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists closing at 3:00 a.m. most nights and 4:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; confirm the current schedule before leaving.
